evidenceScope: Historical R9 reconnect and isolated logger prototype results. Integrated R10 logging, final offline checks, and remaining fleet limits are recorded in r10-diagnostics-2026-09-05.json.

methodology.production: Fixed snapshots of the supplied content-free logs; no production listener access.
methodology.canary: Small synthetic Responses/Anthropic requests with the existing verifier settings. Not a matching workload benchmark of production response times.
methodology.reconnect: Forced control-socket restoration requires a fresh signed rotation challenge. Natural close-to-next-proof can include idle time and is not a request latency measurement.
methodology.failures: All attempts are retained. An unsuccessful fleet or a soak that did not start is not a passed gate.
methodology.connectionControls: Same y-websocket/ws dependencies under Bun and Node, without GhostProv supervisor, bootstrap or model-execution code.

incompleteGates: Complete eight-project recovery on the final tree
